review:
Sweet Powernudge is a 6x5 candy slot where five or more matching symbols form a win. Whenever a win lands, every reel holding at least one winning symbol nudges down to reveal a new symbol, potentially creating further wins without a new spin.

Reel five carries multiplier values that can boost base-game wins. Four scatters award seven free spins, where the multiplier meter is always active. Additional scatters collected during the round count towards a retrigger: four or more award three extra spins. Pragmatic Play's in-game screens advertise up to 4,000x. The RTP is 96.08%. It's a lighter, more modest Powernudge game than Sugar Supreme.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
